name: testimonial-swiper
title: Testimonial Swiper
description: Editorial testimonial slider with split-text quote transitions and directional controls

changelog.summary: Added testimonials and bgColor as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (autoplay, autoplayDelay, accentColor, showNavigation) didn't match this component's real API, so they were replaced with the props TestimonialComp actually accepts.
Under reduced motion, use opacity fade instead of SplitText slides
